question: Which of the following temple is situated in Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shore temple**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Shore Temple is situated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is a complex of temples and shrines that overlooks the shore of the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is located in Mahabalipuram, about 60 kilometres (37 mi) south of Chennai in Tamil Nadu, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Shore Temple is one of the** Group of Monuments at Mahabalipura**m, which is a** UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 1984**.

 
 
• It was built during the** Pallava dynasty, which ruled over Tamil Nadu from the 6th to the 9th centuries.**
 
• It is a Dravidian temple, which is a style of architecture that is found in South India.
 
• It is dedicated to **Shiva and Vishnu, **who are two of the most important Hindu gods.
 
• **It is a popular tourist destination, and it is one of the most visited temples in Tamil Nadu.**
